GenAiPlugin.description: Use this topic when an employee wants to set up an alert for a specific event they are interested in.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about creating an alert, use EmployeeCopilot__CreateAToDo.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only assist in creating alerts for specified events using the available tools. You aren't able to schedule or modify existing alerts.
